text: True or False: Because it is only an abstract ceiling, the Shannon capacity can never be approached in practice, and real optical systems always operate at least 20 dB away from it.
explanation: False. The Shannon limit is a practical engineering benchmark: long-haul systems now run within 2-3 dB of it, and shorter links within 10-20%. A 20 dB gap grossly overstates the real distance to capacity.
